name: Wildblock: Shared Expeditions & Keyboard Controls
creator: Mod_Creator.html
merge: Data-only .htminecraft mod loader and offline authoring tool
notes: All runtime game images and fonts are embedded in the game HTML.
No browser-local user saves or installed packages are included.
Custom uploaded block icons do not inject new world atlas textures.
New worlds use terrain v5; terrain v4 uses unchanged overworld generator, and versions 1-3 retain legacy dispatch.
All roadmap updates are not complete. See RELEASE-NOTES.md for scope and remaining limitations.
No Nether generation/progression is added. Original preexisting content is preserved.
Existing saves keep original terrain; new geodes/tuff/emerald deposits require new terrain-v5 worlds.
Finite amethyst-shell harvesting, not budding-amethyst growth. See README for gameplay adaptations.
Frontiers streamed mode is solo-only and uses terrain v6 / height128. Existing finite saves retain terrain versions1–5 and height64.
Infinite-style describes continuous horizontal streaming, not exact Minecraft parity or unlimited browser storage.
Workshop adds content only: no generator formulas or identifiers changed. No new Nether content.
Recipe/container-return, connection geometry, lantern/chain placement, pumpkin crop semantics are documented in README.
Current runtime counts: 634 blocks,729 inventory items,483 crafting recipes. All 60 new recipes tested.
worldGeneration: World-coordinate continent/erosion/ridge/climate fields, interpolated density caves, biome vegetation, depth-based ore clusters and sparse features
waterSimulation: Queued falling/spreading/draining, radius and update budgets, persistent flow levels
hosting: Static GitHub Pages; no build step or backend
coOp: PeerJS custom eight-character room IDs; automatic signaling
testStatus: Scoped tests in progress; see report

lighting.blockLight: Regional voxel propagation in every preset
lighting.fastMode: Direct-column skylight plus propagated block light

accountType: Portable encrypted public-key identities; no cloud accounts

rendering.adaptiveResolution: Optional; default floor 0.85 in Smooth & Sharp

streamedWorldMode: Rolling local simulation with global procedural terrain and sparse persistent edits
